objective: Resincronizar exclusivamente dbo.Finanzas_CortesCaja_DetallePagos de CIENFUEGOS para agosto 2026 usando la extraccion SoftRestaurant corregida en R54 con tipo de cambio historico por pago. No modificar Sync_Sales, Resumen de Cuentas, Comandas de Venta, Ventas por Periodo, Formas de Pago (Corte), MPRO ni Produccion. Certificar el total de pagos contra el control ejecutivo de 3,959,563.00 y los folios 104124 y 104623.

queries.name: cienfuegos_aug26_payments_summary
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS filas_pago, COUNT(DISTINCT NumeroTicket) AS tickets_con_pago, CAST(ISNULL(SUM(Importe),0) AS decimal(18,2)) AS pagos_total, CAST(ISNULL(SUM(Propina),0) AS decimal(18,2)) AS propina_total, CAST(ISNULL(SUM(Importe),0)-3959563.00 AS decimal(18,2)) AS diferencia_vs_ejecutivo FROM dbo.Finanzas_CortesCaja_DetallePagos WHERE UnidadNegocio='CIENFUEGOS' AND FechaHora>='2026-08-01' AND FechaHora<'2026-09-01' AND ISNULL(Activo,1)=1

queries.name: cienfuegos_aug26_gap_tickets_after_resync
queries.sql: SELECT NumeroTicket AS folio, CAST(SUM(ISNULL(Importe,0)) AS decimal(18,2)) AS total_pago, CAST(SUM(ISNULL(Propina,0)) AS decimal(18,2)) AS propina, COUNT(*) AS filas_pago FROM dbo.Finanzas_CortesCaja_DetallePagos WHERE UnidadNegocio='CIENFUEGOS' AND NumeroTicket IN ('104124','104623') AND FechaHora>='2026-08-01' AND FechaHora<'2026-09-01' AND ISNULL(Activo,1)=1 GROUP BY NumeroTicket ORDER BY NumeroTicket

queries.name: cienfuegos_aug26_usd_payment_rows_after_resync
queries.sql: SELECT NumeroTicket AS folio, FormaPagoCodigo, FormaPago, CAST(Importe AS decimal(18,2)) AS importe_mxn, CAST(Propina AS decimal(18,2)) AS propina_mxn FROM dbo.Finanzas_CortesCaja_DetallePagos WHERE UnidadNegocio='CIENFUEGOS' AND NumeroTicket IN ('104124','104623') AND FormaPagoCodigo='03' AND FechaHora>='2026-08-01' AND FechaHora<'2026-09-01' AND ISNULL(Activo,1)=1 ORDER BY NumeroTicket

queries.name: cienfuegos_aug26_duplicate_hash_check
queries.sql: SELECT HashOrigen, COUNT(*) AS duplicados FROM dbo.Finanzas_CortesCaja_DetallePagos WHERE UnidadNegocio='CIENFUEGOS' AND FechaHora>='2026-08-01' AND FechaHora<'2026-09-01' AND ISNULL(Activo,1)=1 GROUP BY HashOrigen HAVING COUNT(*)>1

queries.name: cienfuegos_aug26_expected_amount_gate
queries.sql: SELECT CAST(ISNULL(SUM(Importe),0) AS decimal(18,2)) AS pagos_total, CASE WHEN ABS(CAST(ISNULL(SUM(Importe),0) AS decimal(18,2))-CAST(3959563.00 AS decimal(18,2)))<=0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS pagos_total_ok FROM dbo.Finanzas_CortesCaja_DetallePagos WHERE UnidadNegocio='CIENFUEGOS' AND FechaHora>='2026-08-01' AND FechaHora<'2026-09-01' AND ISNULL(Activo,1)=1
